reauth_confirm.title: Verdi needs a new token
reauth_confirm.description:
Verdi rejected the token, or no token arrived. Usually the Verdi Token Relay app fixes this on its own:

1. Check that the Verdi Token Relay app is running.
2. If its log says the login needs interaction, redo the one-time login on a PC with the relay script.
3. Copy the new verdi_state.json into the app's configuration folder and restart the app.

This prompt closes itself when the next token arrives. Pasting a token below is for testing only.

init.title: Verdi options
init.description: With "Show colleagues' names" off, on-duty sensors show filled or open and calendar events show only the function. When on, colleagues' names and shift times are stored in Home Assistant's history. Each lookup is fetched only when it is due: personnel and vehicles every tick, the rest when the station data shows a change, at a time Verdi announced, or after its safety interval. Statuses Verdi sets when someone is called are always included and counted. You can also paste an availability ID.

data.intervention_interval: Tick during an intervention (seconds, at least 15)
data.watched_vehicles: Vehicles that count for interventions (none picked: all)
data.non_pageable: Availabilities that cannot be paged (none picked: guessed from the name)

fast_lane.name: Fast lane
fast_lane.description: Polled at the fast tick instead of the station tick.

own_data.name: Your own data from the Verdi app
own_data.description: Read with the same token through the read commands of Verdi's app route. Switched off: nothing is fetched and the entities are not created.

data.status_changes: Change my status from Home Assistant
data.calendar_edit: Add and remove planned statuses from the availability calendar

data_description.status_changes: Adds actions, two selects and two buttons to set your status now, end it, plan a status and remove a planned one. Only Home Assistant administrators (and automations) can use them.
data_description.calendar_edit: Home Assistant's calendar view can't tell who is using it: with this on, anyone who can open the calendar can add or remove your planned statuses and end a running one. Needs "Change my status" and the calendars.

safety.name: Safety intervals
safety.description: The longest time between two fetches when nothing signals a change.

data.roster_safety: Roster and roster calendar (minutes, at least 10)
data.statistics_interval: Statistics (hours, at least 1; also daily after midnight and after an intervention)

error.availabilities_not_loaded: Verdi's availability list hasn't loaded yet, so an availability can't be removed now. Try again in a few minutes.
error.calendar_edit_needs: Adding and removing from the calendar needs "Change my status" and "My shifts and availability calendars" on.
